steps.title: Establish App Meta-Configuration
steps.description: Establish the application meta descriptor containing app name 'Voice Control Assistant' and package identifier 'com.voicecontrolassistant.app'.

steps.title: Configure Accessibility Service Rules
steps.description: Ensure configurations are set for retrieval of interactive window contents and view resource IDs.

steps.title: Declare Hardware and System Camera Permissions
steps.description: Add camera and flashlight permission controls to AndroidManifest.xml for programmatically managing torch features.

steps.title: Expand Supported Voice Command Dashboard Guidelines
steps.description: Update resource strings containing helpful Hindi and English execution examples for torch, volume, and power commands.

steps.title: Integrate Bilingual English and Hindi Speech Recognition Engine
steps.description: Configure android.speech SpeechRecognizer intent values to listen for English and Hindi (hi-IN) voice utterances simultaneously.

steps.title: Implement English and Hindi Command Parser Tokenizer
steps.description: Develop multi-lingual lexical matching patterns in parser for voice volume control, flashlight toggling, and device rebooting.

steps.title: Develop Flashlight Torch Hardware Toggle Routine
steps.description: Implement CameraManager torch controls targeting device flashlight APIs compatible with Android M and above.

steps.title: Develop Audio Stream Volume Adjuster Routine
steps.description: Use AudioManager to programmatically increase or decrease music and ringer volumes with native sliders on screen.

steps.title: Develop Power Menu Dialog and Root-Fallback Restart Module
steps.description: Trigger Global Power Dialog option for modern non-rooted user devices and fallback to runtime superuser commands.

steps.title: Review Main Activity Core Permission Layout Bindings
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity dynamic app listing and service setup dashboard elements function seamlessly with the revised modules.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Assemble, compile, and build the updated Voice Control Assistant using Gradle command line utilities.
